ZenithNadir

Zenith and Nadir The power of Miala, Gammon and Tethrys wax and wane upon the surface of Solmaria, but at their zenith and nadir they speak to animal, tree and stone. They speak the loudest at their Zenith, as they rise high into the sky. Likewise, they become silent at their Nadir, when they are far below us.
《天顶与天底》 米亚拉、加蒙与泰丝瑞斯的力量在索尔玛利亚的地表消长不息；而当它们行至天顶与天底时，便会向走兽、树木与石头开口。天顶之时，它们高升于空，声音最为洪亮；天底之时，它们远行于我们脚下，便归于缄默。

ZenithNadir
Do not confuse this speech with the other blessings they bestow. Listen, and watch, and you may yet understand. The moons are more than stone and metal. They speak, and Solmaria responds.
莫把这番言语与它们赐下的其他恩泽混为一谈。聆听，注视，你或能领会：月亮不只是石头与金属。它们开口，索尔玛利亚便会回应。

res#60198/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Miala

Miala, the silver moon: It is under the gaze of Miala that we find our world blessed with strange and wonderful things. Long she hangs in the sky, as the other moons and stars pass by. Nothing brightens the night as much as Miala, and before her wounding it was even more so! When Miala was fractured it rained fire upon Solmaria, but fire was not all that visited us.
米亚拉，银之月： 正是在米亚拉的注视之下，我们的世界得享奇异而美妙之物的祝福。她长久悬于天际，看其他月亮与星辰往来掠去。没有什么能像米亚拉那样照亮黑夜——在她受创之前，更是如此！米亚拉碎裂之时，火雨降于索尔玛利亚；但降临我们这里的，并不只有火。
res#60198/whatIHaveToSay[2]
Miala

New metals, and odd beings came as well; some wonderful, some terrible and all strange. It is from Miala that the Fairy came to live upon our world, and also Feary, their vile and wicked kin. This is why silver is such a bane to them, for it connects them to the home that they lost.

	 Some say that magic itself is from Miala, though Solmaria is grand enough to merit its own wonders. Even so, it may be that she has always had an influence on the arcane.

新的金属与奇异的存有也随之而来：有的奇妙，有的可怖，无一不古怪。住在我们世界上的「妖精」，正是从米亚拉而来；他们的邪恶亲族「妖孽」亦然。这便是银器成为他们克星的原因——银，连着他们失去的故乡。

	 有人说，魔法本身就源自米亚拉；不过索尔玛利亚足够宏大，自有其奇迹。即便如此，她对奥术的影响也许自古有之。
res#60198/whatIHaveToSay[3]
Miala

When Miala rises, all that is magic is intensified; both the good and the bad. Even in death or mortal wounding she blesses our land. Miala will always represent holiness and wonder, even on the day she finally falls from the sky.
米亚拉升起时，一切魔法之物都会增强——良善的与邪恶的，皆然。即便身负致命之伤、乃至破碎之后，她仍庇佑着我们的土地。米亚拉永远象征着神圣与奇迹——直到她从天空坠落的那一天。

res#60935/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Tethrys

Tethrys, the trickster moon: It has long been the tradition of those who seek to remain unseen to travel in the light of Tethrys. His light is not like that of the other moons, or of the sun. It has texture, and flavor. The light ripples across the ground, breaking the order of vision's expectation, just as the sun casts its light onto a stream's sandy bottom. Quickly he passes through the sky, darting between the shadows of Solmaria and her moons.
泰丝瑞斯，狡黠之月： 对于想要隐去行踪的人，借泰丝瑞斯之光行路，历来是他们的传统。他的光不同于其他月亮，也不同于太阳——它有肌理，有韵味。那光在地面上荡漾起伏，打破视觉的惯常秩序，如同阳光洒落溪底沙床。他迅速掠过天空，在索尔玛利亚与她诸月投下的阴影之间腾挪闪转。
res#60935/whatIHaveToSay[2]
Tethrys
If you seek to go unseen, travel under Tethrys. He will protect you on your journey. Prying eyes will not find you.
若你欲隐去踪迹，便在泰丝瑞斯之下出行。他会一路庇佑你。窥探之眼寻不见你。

res#60969/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Gammon

Gammon, the elemental moon: Gammon is the closest moon to Solmaria. In his light and shadow our oceans and landmasses move. His pull is great, and his power beyond our control. When he vanishes from sight, the cold is harsher. When he reaches his peak, fires roar in anger. At the horizon, both earth and storm are empowered, for in truth they are one and the same. He casts his red glow upon the land, strengthening the hues of the sunset.
加蒙，元素之月： 加蒙是距索尔玛利亚最近的月亮。在他光影流转之间，我们的海洋与陆块随之移动。他的引力浩大，伟力超乎我们的掌控。当他隐没不见，严寒更甚；当他行至极处，火焰怒吼。行至地平线时，大地与风暴皆得其力——因为它们本就是一体。他把红光洒向大地，将夕照染得愈发浓烈。
res#60969/whatIHaveToSay[2]
Gammon

Gammon's influence is immense. Ignore his power at your own risk, or fall to his whims without knowledge of why your path is altered.

	Wise is he who regards Gammon with fear and trembling. He has the power to wither crops and to sweep away homes or bury them in snow.

加蒙的影响浩大无边。无视他的伟力，后果自负——否则你将在不知不觉间听凭他的意旨改道而行。

	以敬畏之心看待加蒙者，是明智的。他有摧枯拉朽、扫屋埋雪之力。
